description.value: Municipal campground on a forested island in the Skeena River at Terrace, reached by a short bridge; a calm riverside base with walking trails around the island perimeter and the big-river atmosphere of one of BC's great salmon systems.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a municipal campground operated by the City of Terrace with a capacity of 100 sites. The website URL resolves to the City of Terrace site and the page title 'Ferry Island Municipal Campground | City of Terrace' confirms the facility's existence and operator; however, the fetched content consists almost entirely of repeated navigation menus with no campground-specific body text, so specific amenities cannot be confirmed from the website. All optional amenity values are set to null because no positive or negative evidence appears in the available content.
concerns: Website body content was not captured — only navigation menus rendered; amenity details should be verified manually or via a direct phone inquiry to City of Terrace Parks, Recreation & Culture.
No address or phone number present in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate 100-site municipal campground operated by the City of Terrace, directly on a major touring corridor (Hwy 16); clear value for cycle tourists despite sparse amenity detail.

wow_evidence: 100-site municipal campground...forested island in the Skeena River...directly on a major touring corridor (Hwy 16)
